newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hoechst completes Australia plastics exit.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst completes Australia plastics exit.

text.p: German chemicals group Hoechst AG has completed its exit from the Australian plastics industry, selling its polypropylene compounds business to BASF.
Hoechst Australia Ltd announced the sale late on Friday.

It declined to reveal the price. The plastics sale follows the sale in January of the bulk of Hoechst's Australian plastics business to Kemcor Australia Ltd, a joint venture between oil majors Mobil Corp and Exxon Corp.
Australia's plastics industry has become increasingly exposed to competition from Asian imports, leading to a consolidation in the local industry.
BASF Australia Ltd, a unit of German chemicals group BASF, said the purchase of Hoechst's polypropylene compounds business enabled it to offer the widest range of engineering plastics in Australia.
